notes.title: Simple Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Just a bug fix update, mainly fixing a silly issue where I left a debug flag enabled causing limited items to always spawn in every spawn location... hope you managed to farm the limited items while you could ;)

notes.title: v1.6b - A simple, helpful update
notes.notes:
This is a simple update that adds a video help section. Pressing "H" (or "Select" on controller) at any time in the game will bring up a help menu with various help topics about the game.

For those who think they don't need a full tutorial room or want a quick refresher, this may be helpful :)

notes.title: Version 0.9.6b
notes.notes:
[b]Version 0.9.6b[/b]
A small bug fix patch fixing a few things logged from the launch version.

The most notable fixes:
+ The shadow boxes were incorrect on the story farm map
+ The choice buttons from the intro would rarely not register the click

There was one small balance change as well:
+ The Cake limited item was buffed to heal 75% health instead of 50%
